title: Research apprenticeship
prerequisites: At least P5 to P9; choose a project within completed preparation.
purpose: Turn a precise question into a reproducible investigation with an explicit baseline, uncertainty and falsification criteria.
primary_reading: FAU Physics program and research requirements

blocks.deliverable: Define one narrow question and identify three primary sources.
Write assumptions, units and acceptance criteria before testing.
Reproduce a known result and seek an independent check.
Hold a midcourse review before adding one model change.
Record what would falsify the claim and test relevant limits.
Invite a qualified reader to identify mathematical or inference errors.
Deliver a corrected report with unresolved issues clearly stated.

project: Write a 6 to 10 page research report with code or derivations, a claim audit and an oral presentation.
completion: finish the final project and practical or oral assessment, repair issues found during review, and retain the full data or code and a short account of remaining limitations.
